subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Control UI for Multi-Agent + Subagent Orchestration (Hierarchy, Bulk Ops, and Scalability)

question: Which Control UI surface should own runtime subagent orchestration: an expanded Sessions mode, a dedicated Orchestration/Mission Board route, or a Workboard/task-backed hybrid?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable product boundary and privileged bulk-operation semantics are not determined by current code or tests.

options.title: Stage a Sessions-based hierarchy first
options.body: Extend the existing Sessions surface with a read-only agent/session/subagent hierarchy, active-first filters, and scalability proof before adding bulk controls.

options.title: Create a dedicated Orchestration route
options.body: Add a new route for runtime operations if maintainers want mission-board concepts separated from session administration and Workboard cards.

options.title: Wait for backend contracts first
options.body: Pause UI implementation until session-chain and run-progress contracts settle, then build one view over those canonical fields.

recommendation.title: Stage a Sessions-based hierarchy first
recommendation.body: Extend the existing Sessions surface with a read-only agent/session/subagent hierarchy, active-first filters, and scalability proof before adding bulk controls.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product-boundary and core Control UI direction choice, and steipete is the best available owner from the current history and VISION/product guardrail trail.
